journeys.title: Amending a live event
journeys.goal: Change a published event — dates, terms, items — with a remark, tell the vendors, have them acknowledge it again, and keep bids placed before and after the change honest.

cases.title: "Create New Version" appears only when the backend allows it
cases.why: The button is the only guard the product actually applies (the API does not, API-XDAMD-006).
cases.setup: Two events: one where `config.can_create_new_version` is true, one with an approved award.
cases.steps: Open each event's details; look at the tab bar's right side.
cases.expected: Button (or the "Create New Version" option inside the version dropdown) shown only for the first.
cases.oracle: Visibility matches `config.can_create_new_version` from `GET /event_groups/:id`.

cases.title: Withdrawing an amendment draft
cases.why: The draft footer shows a red Withdraw button; its backend effect freezes the original (API-XDAMD-019).
cases.setup: Amendment draft.
cases.steps: Click Withdraw; try OK with an empty and a whitespace-only remark; then with a real one.
cases.expected: OK disabled until a non-blank remark (trimmed, max 500 chars); success toast "Draft project withdrawn successfully"; redirect to the live tab. Then open the original: it should be either live-and-latest or withdrawn — not stuck.
cases.oracle: Original's `is_latest_version` after withdrawal.

cases.title: The confirmation explains the consequences and Cancel creates nothing
cases.why: The modal promises old bids become read-only and fresh bids are needed; that text is the buyer's only warning.
cases.setup: An event where versioning is allowed.
cases.steps: Click Create New Version; read the modal; click Cancel; reload.
cases.expected: Title "Are you sure you want to create a new version?", three bullets (archive, bids read-only, collect fresh bids), "This action cannot be undone."; Cancel sends no request.
cases.oracle: No `POST /item_versions` in the network log; `item_versions` still empty.

cases.title: Confirming opens the amendment draft in the create screen
cases.why: The redirect carries the new event and its draft stages; a wrong id edits the original.
cases.setup: As above.
cases.steps: Confirm the modal.
cases.expected: Navigates to the create screen with `projectCreation=true&projectId=<new uuid>&draftStageIds=<new stage uuids>&isEditingAllowed=true` (and `boqProject` for BOQ events).
cases.oracle: URL params equal `new_item_data` from the response.

cases.title: In an amendment draft stages cannot be deleted or added
cases.why: The amendment must keep the event's stage structure.
cases.setup: Amendment draft open in the create screen.
cases.steps: Open a stage tab's menu; look for the Add Stages dropdown.
cases.expected: "Delete" disabled; Add Stages dropdown not rendered.
cases.oracle: Menu item disabled attribute; dropdown absent.

cases.title: Addendum Remarks are required to publish an amendment
cases.why: The remark is what vendors are told.
cases.setup: Amendment draft, all stages reviewed.
cases.steps: Click Publish; try OK with an empty remark, with " ", then with a 5,000-character remark.
cases.expected: Field labelled "Addendum Remarks *"; OK disabled while empty. Today " " enables OK (no trim) and there is no length limit — both should be fixed to match the withdraw modal.
cases.oracle: OK button enabled state; request body `amendment_remarks.remarks`.

cases.title: An old version's settings menu disables changing actions
cases.why: The backend refuses these on a non-latest event (101); the UI should not offer them.
cases.setup: Open the original (v1) of an amended event.
cases.steps: Open the stage Settings menu.
cases.expected: Disabled: final price, recreate, split line items, extend submission time, end time, extend CBD time, withdraw, convert to auction, edit evaluation time, unlock bids, re-evaluation, stop auto awarding, bulk vendor skip approval. Check also Reschedule (offered only for upcoming) and Reject bid — neither checks the version.
cases.oracle: Disabled attribute per item.

cases.title: Awarding is blocked on an old version with a reason
cases.why: An award on v1 would point at bids the buyer was told are read-only.
cases.setup: v1 of an amended event with bids.
cases.steps: Open the QCS/award view; hover the award action.
cases.expected: Award disabled; tooltip "Awarding is only allowed for the latest version".
cases.oracle: Tooltip text.

cases.title: In-place edits of a live stage disappear after the first bid
cases.why: The screen allows title, T&C and savings edits only while upcoming/live with zero bids; the API still accepts T&C edits with bids until close (API-XDAMD-049). The two rules should match.
cases.setup: A live RFQ; then the same after one vendor bid.
cases.steps: Open the Details panels (Order details, Terms & Conditions, Savings) before and after the bid.
cases.expected: Edit buttons present before, absent after.
cases.oracle: Presence of the OrderEditButton per panel.

cases.title: Vendor selection in an amendment draft
cases.why: The participant picker's disable rule includes "is amendment draft", but it is ANDed with "not a draft project" and an amendment draft IS a draft, so the picker may stay editable — vendors added here would join v2 without being on v1.
cases.setup: Amendment draft of a live RFQ.
cases.steps: Open the stage's participants field; try to add and remove a vendor; publish.
cases.expected: Decide and document; today verify whether the picker is enabled and whether the change reaches v2's audience.
cases.oracle: Picker disabled state; v2 audience after publish.

cases.title: What an invited vendor sees after an amendment
cases.why: There is no "event updated" banner for vendors in this repository; the vendor learns of the amendment only from the "<ref> | Event Revised" email (and a push) that carries the remark.
cases.setup: QA vendor invited to an RFQ; buyer publishes an amendment with remark "QA_Platform_{{stamp}}".
cases.steps: As the vendor: check the mailbox, open the event from the mail and from the live list, try to bid on the old link.
cases.expected: Mail subject "<ref> | Event Revised" with the remark; the new version opens; the old link refuses bids. Note today: the event vanishes from the live list while the amendment is drafted (API-XDAMD-016).
cases.oracle: Mail received; bid on old link refused (101).

cases.title: The Addendum panel shows the amendment remark
cases.why: Buyers reviewing an event must see why it was amended.
cases.setup: A published amendment with remark "QA_Platform_{{stamp}}"; and a never-amended event.
cases.steps: Open each event's Details tab.
cases.expected: "Addendum" panel with the remark above Overview on the amended event; no panel on the other.
cases.oracle: Panel text equals `amendment_remarks.remarks`.

cases.title: The version dropdown lists every version, newest labelled Latest
cases.why: It is how buyers move between v1 and v2.
cases.setup: An event amended once (published).
cases.steps: Open the dropdown; pick the older version.
cases.expected: Entries `<ref>.1 (Latest)` and `<ref>`; picking one navigates to that version's details tab.
cases.oracle: Labels equal `item_versions[].label`; URL id changes.

cases.title: Send to Evaluation is disabled on an old version
cases.why: Evaluations on v1 waste evaluator time (API-XDAMD-018).
cases.setup: v1 of an amended RFP with responses.
cases.steps: Open the RFP stage header.
cases.expected: "Send to Evaluation" disabled.
cases.oracle: Disabled attribute.

cases.title: Reject bid is still offered on an old version
cases.why: Every other changing action is disabled on v1; Reject bid is not, so the buyer can act on bids the modal called read-only.
cases.setup: v1 of an amended RFQ with bids.
cases.steps: Open Settings; click Reject bid and complete it.
cases.expected: Should be disabled. Record what the backend answers.
cases.oracle: Menu item state; bid status after.

cases.title: Reschedule is offered only before the stage starts
cases.why: The backend refuses a reschedule once started (code 258); the UI hides it then.
cases.setup: One upcoming stage, one live stage.
cases.steps: Open Settings on each.
cases.expected: "Reschedule" only on the upcoming stage.
cases.oracle: Menu item presence.

cases.title: "Add new Stage" follows the backend configuration
cases.why: The menu label, hidden and disabled state all come from `add_new_stage_config`; it must be hidden on old versions and on anything but an RFP-only live event.
cases.setup: `is_add_new_stage_allowed` ON; an RFP-only live event, an RFQ-only event, and v1 of an amended RFP-only event.
cases.steps: Open Settings on each.
cases.expected: "Add new Stage" enabled only on the RFP-only live latest event; confirmation text "Do you want to add a new RFQ Stage?".
cases.oracle: Menu item disabled state vs `tradeConfig.addNewStageConfig`.

cases.title: A scheduled (recurring) template shows Edit instead of versions
cases.why: Templates are edited in place; versioning them would fork the schedule.
cases.setup: A recurring event template.
cases.steps: Open its details.
cases.expected: No version dropdown / Create New Version; an "Edit" button instead.
cases.oracle: Element presence.

cases.title: The API versions an event even when the company has versioning switched off
cases.why: The "Create New Version" button is driven by `can_create_new_version?`, which checks the company setting `is_event_versioning_enabled`, draft/withdrawn state, latest, awarded proposals, lot split, post-auction and team membership. `POST /item_versions` checks none of these — it only asks "active and latest" plus the create-record permission. Any client (or a stale tab) can amend events the product says cannot be amended.
cases.setup: A company with `is_event_versioning_enabled` OFF; a published event. Not a runnable twin: the setting is not in the dashboard configuration the runner reads, so the case cannot be gated and would be a false positive on a company where versioning is on.
cases.steps: 1. `GET /event_groups/:id` and confirm `config.can_create_new_version` is false. 2. `POST /item_versions` with `{"item_uuid": ":id", "item_type": "EventGroup"}`.
cases.expected: Should be refused (422) whenever `can_create_new_version` is false. Today: HTTP 200 with a new draft version.
cases.oracle: A 200 here while step 1 said false is the defect; `GET` the original afterwards shows `is_latest_version: false`.

cases.title: An event whose award proposal is already submitted can still be versioned
cases.why: `can_create_new_version?` refuses once a proposal is selected, requested or active; the API does not. A version issued after award orphans the award on a superseded event.
cases.setup: The journey's own event after `award_submit`. The journey's F2 step (`version`, run when `events.versioning` is ticked) sends exactly this request last, so no separate twin is needed — read that step's verdict.
cases.steps: `POST /item_versions` with the journey event's uuid (the journey's F2 step).
cases.expected: Should be 422 (proposal in requested/selected). Today: 200 — the controller never consults proposals.
cases.oracle: The F2 step answering 200 while `GET /event_groups/:id` showed `config.can_create_new_version: false` is the defect.

cases.section: While the amendment is being drafted — the original is frozen
cases.title: Vendors cannot start, update or submit a bid on the original while the amendment is drafted
cases.why: The original is no longer the latest the moment the draft version exists; bids there would be lost.
cases.setup: A versioned event (draft amendment exists), original stage still open; vendor session. No twin (vendor actor).
cases.steps: As the vendor: `POST /v1/bids`, `PATCH /v1/bids/:id`, `POST /v1/bids/:id/create_bid_products`, and a commercial submit.
cases.expected: The first three: HTTP 422 code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action'. The submit service: code 805 'Invalid action type' — a misleading message for "this version is superseded".
cases.oracle: No bid rows change.

cases.section: While the amendment is being drafted — the original is frozen
cases.title: Revising a submitted bid on the superseded version is not blocked
cases.why: `PATCH /bids/revise_bid/:id` (the legacy revise path) has no latest-version check, so while the amendment is drafted (the original's window is still open) a vendor can still move prices on the version that is about to be archived.
cases.setup: A vendor with an active bid on the original; buyer has created a new version but not yet published it. No twin (vendor actor).
cases.steps: As the vendor, `PATCH /bids/revise_bid/:bid` with a lower price.
cases.expected: Should be 101 like the v1 bid endpoints. Today: accepted.
cases.oracle: Bid price changed after the version was created.

cases.section: While the amendment is being drafted — the original is frozen
cases.title: An award proposal on the superseded version can still be submitted
cases.why: Proposal creation checks "latest", but adding responses and submitting an existing proposal do not, so an award can be approved on a version vendors were told is archived.
cases.setup: Journey state (proposal created, not yet submitted), then the event is versioned. No twin (needs the journey's event uuid).
cases.steps: `POST /proposal/<uuid>/add_response` and `/submit` on the original's proposal.
cases.expected: Should be 101. Today: only `POST /proposal` refuses (101).
cases.oracle: Proposal status advances on a non-latest event.

cases.section: While the amendment is being drafted — the original is frozen
cases.title: Withdrawing the amendment draft freezes the original for good
cases.why: The amendment screen offers "Withdraw". Withdrawing a draft marks its ItemVersion ACTIVE (the status callback treats withdrawn like active), so the original stays non-latest forever — no edits, no bids, no award — while its stages stay open and visible because the previous version is force-closed only on a draft→active publish.
cases.setup: Live event, amendment draft created; buyer withdraws the draft with a remark.
cases.steps: 1. `PATCH /event_groups/<draft>` with `{"status": "withdrawn", "withdraw_remark": {"remarks": "QA_Platform_{{stamp}}"}}`. 2. `GET` the original. 3. As vendor, try to bid on the original.
cases.expected: Either the original becomes latest again or it is withdrawn too. Today: original `is_latest_version: false`, its stage still active, vendor bids answer 101.
cases.oracle: item_versions row status = active pointing at a withdrawn draft.

cases.section: Publishing the amendment — remark, notification, re-acceptance, old bids
cases.title: Publishing the amendment force-closes the previous version
cases.why: Vendors must not keep bidding on v1 once v2 is live; the close happens in an async worker, so there is a window where both are open.
cases.setup: Live event with an open stage, amendment published.
cases.steps: Immediately and again after a few seconds, `GET /trade/<old stage>`.
cases.expected: Old stages' bid end time = publish time (end_time_for force_close_event); old event group status stays active; PR mappings point to the new version.
cases.oracle: Old trade schedule end_time ≈ publish time.

cases.section: Publishing the amendment — remark, notification, re-acceptance, old bids
cases.title: Bids placed before the amendment stay on the old version and are not carried over
cases.why: The confirmation modal promises "all bids received on the previous version" become read-only and fresh bids are needed; the backend must match that promise.
cases.setup: Vendor bid on v1, then amendment published. Vendor session for the last step.
cases.steps: 1. `GET /trade/<old stage>`: bid still there. 2. `GET /trade/<new stage>`: no bids. 3. As vendor, revise on old (should fail) and bid on new (should work).
cases.expected: Old bids untouched and read-only; new stage empty; vendor can bid on v2.
cases.oracle: Bid counts per stage.

cases.section: Editing a live event in place — the amendment bypass (`PATCH /event_groups/:id`)
cases.title: A live line item's quantity can be changed without a version
cases.why: This is the core bypass: what is being bought changes on a published event with no version, no remark and no vendor notice, and the RFQ line vendors quote against keeps the old quantity.
cases.setup: The sandbox event (published, one open RFQ stage, one line item, no bids). Runs last because it changes the line item.
cases.steps: `PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}` with body `{"line_items": [{"uuid": "{{lineItemUuid}}", "product_uuid": "{{productUuid}}", "product_quality_uuid": "{{productQualityUuid}}", "quantity": {"unitSymbol": "KG", "value": 7}}]}`. Then read the line items and the stage.
cases.expected: Should be refused or routed through a new version. Today: HTTP 200; the event line item says 7, the stage's trade product still says the original quantity, and no "Event Revised" mail is sent.
cases.oracle: `GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/get_line_items` vs `GET /trade/{{tradeId}}` quantities differ.

cases.section: Editing a live stage in place (`PATCH /trade/:id`)
cases.title: A delivery schedule of another company's event can be edited
cases.why: `DeliverySchedule.where(id: …)` has no scope to the stage or company, so a buyer can move another tenant's delivery date by id.
cases.setup: Two companies; the id of a delivery schedule owned by company B. Security, manual only — must never run against real records.
cases.steps: As company A's buyer, `PATCH /trade/<A's live stage>` with `{"delivery_schedules": [{"id": <B's id>, "delivery_by": <time>}]}`.
cases.expected: 422/404. Today: B's schedule is updated.
cases.oracle: B's delivery_by changed.

cases.section: Version guards and reading the audit trail back
cases.title: Any signed-in user can read any company's change log
cases.why: The controller has no policy and no tenant scope: `Version.where(item_type:, item_id:)` with a raw integer id returns every column change (and who made it) for any company, user, team, stage or bid on the platform.
cases.setup: Two tenants you control (A and B). Security, manual only — never point this at a real tenant's ids.
cases.steps: As A's buyer, `GET /versions_log/all?entity_type=TradeRequest&entity_id=<B's stage id>` (and `Company`, `User`).
cases.expected: 455/404. Today: 200 with B's history.
cases.oracle: Response contains B's changes and user details.

cases.title: Versioning an event that does not exist
cases.why: The same code (888) answers "not found", "not live" and "not latest", so the screen cannot tell the buyer which one happened.
cases.setup: Any buyer.
cases.steps: `POST /item_versions` with body `{"item_uuid": "Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==", "item_type": "EventGroup"}`.
cases.expected: Refused before the policy runs. HTTP 422, code 888 'Invalid Parameters'.

cases.title: Versioning after an auction ignores allow_versioning_post_auction
cases.why: Re-opening an auction's commercial terms after prices were revealed is exactly what `allow_versioning_post_auction` exists to stop.
cases.setup: `allow_versioning_post_auction` OFF; an event whose latest commercial stage is an auction (e.g. after RFQ→Auction conversion). Needs an auction event; no twin.
cases.steps: Confirm `config.can_create_new_version` is false, then `POST /item_versions` for the event.
cases.expected: Should be refused. Today: 200.
cases.oracle: New version exists despite the setting.

cases.title: Versioning a lot-split event ignores lot_splitting_done?
cases.why: Once lots are published as separate stages, a replica built from `latest_non_lot_commercial_stage` drops the lot stages.
cases.setup: A live event with published lots (lot_config status active). No twin (needs lot split).
cases.steps: `POST /item_versions` for the event.
cases.expected: Should be refused. Today: 200 and a version without the lot stages.
cases.oracle: `new_item_data.trade_uuids` lacks the lot stages.

cases.title: A buyer outside the owner's team can version someone else's event
cases.why: The UI allows versioning only to super admins or users sharing a team with the owner; the API allows anyone in the company with create-record permission.
cases.setup: Buyer B in PROCOL DEMO with create permission, no team shared with the event owner, not super admin. Needs a second buyer; no twin.
cases.steps: As B, `POST /item_versions` for A's live event.
cases.expected: Should be 455. Today: 200.
cases.oracle: Version row `created_by` = B.

cases.title: Two quick "Create New Version" clicks
cases.why: There is no lock; both requests pass the latest check, the second insert hits the unique partial index and surfaces as an untyped 500.
cases.setup: A live event; two concurrent requests (the runner sends cases one at a time, so no twin).
cases.steps: Fire two identical `POST /item_versions` within a few milliseconds.
cases.expected: One 200, one readable 422 (888). Today the loser is likely a 500 from `index_item_versions_unique_active_item`.
cases.oracle: Exactly one draft version and one replica event; no orphan replica.

cases.title: A withdrawn event cannot be versioned
cases.why: Withdrawn is final; reviving it through a version would re-invite vendors who were told it was over.
cases.setup: A withdrawn event. No twin: the runner rebuilds the sandbox right after any withdrawal, so a later case never sees it withdrawn.
cases.steps: `POST /item_versions` for the withdrawn event.
cases.expected: HTTP 422, code 888 'Invalid Parameters' (`!item.active?`).
cases.oracle: No version created.

cases.title: What the new version copies and what it resets
cases.why: Vendors and buyers rely on the amendment carrying the right things: same line items, stages, vendors and evaluators — but no bids.
cases.setup: Run right after EDGE-PUB-096 (or the journey's F2 step) on its own event.
cases.steps: `GET /event_groups/<new uuid>` and `GET /trade/<each new stage>`; compare with the original.
cases.expected: New draft event with copies of the active line items (`meta_data.old_egli_id` set), the RFP stage and the latest non-lot commercial stage as drafts, audiences and access lists copied, schedules re-based to start "now" with the configured duration, `misc.bid_company_ids` / savings / precomputed bids reset, no bids, evaluation scores stripped from line items.
cases.oracle: Field-by-field comparison; bid count 0 on the new stages.

cases.section: While the amendment is being drafted — the original is frozen
cases.title: The original drops off vendors' live page as soon as the version is created
cases.why: The live page lists `TradeRequest.latest`, and the draft version already counts; vendors lose the event from their list for as long as the buyer drafts the amendment, with no notice.
cases.setup: Vendor invited to a live event; buyer creates a new version and leaves it in draft.
cases.steps: As the vendor, load the live page (`GET /orders?tab=live` or the home live list) before and after the version is created.
cases.expected: Product decision needed; today the event disappears for vendors while its window is still open.
cases.oracle: Event present before, absent after.

cases.section: While the amendment is being drafted — the original is frozen
cases.title: Counter offers and evaluations are not guarded on the superseded version
cases.why: Negotiation and scoring on an archived version waste evaluator time and can leak into the QCS.
cases.setup: A closed RFP/RFQ with bids, then versioned. No twin.
cases.steps: Raise a counter offer (`POST /additional_request/raise_additional_request`) and score (`POST /evaluations`) on the original.
cases.expected: Should be 101 (old version). Today: no latest check in either controller.
cases.oracle: New additional_request / evaluation rows on the old version.

cases.section: While the amendment is being drafted — the original is frozen
cases.title: Setting the amendment draft in_active restores the original
cases.why: It is the only path that gives the original back its "latest" status, and it is reachable only by sending `status: in_active` with a config key.
cases.setup: Amendment draft exists.
cases.steps: `PATCH /event_groups/<draft>` with `{"status": "in_active", "config": {"show_reference_id": false}}`, then `GET` the original.
cases.expected: Original `is_latest_version: true` again; vendors can bid. Document as intended or close it.
cases.oracle: item_versions row status in_active.

cases.section: Publishing the amendment — remark, notification, re-acceptance, old bids
cases.title: An amendment remark sent as plain text publishes the amendment and then crashes
cases.why: `add_amendment_remarks!` reads `"text"["remarks"]` (nil) and stores a remark with no message; the notification then calls `params.dig('amendment_remarks','remarks')` on a String, which raises — after the publish has committed. The buyer sees an error for an amendment that went live without the "Event Revised" email.
cases.setup: Amendment draft with its stages.
cases.steps: Publish the draft with `"amendment_remarks": "QA_Platform_reason_{{stamp}}"` (a string, not an object).
cases.expected: 422 (remarks must be an object). Today: event active, version active, then 500.
cases.oracle: Draft is now active and the previous version is force-closed, yet the reply was 5xx and no email job was queued.

cases.section: Publishing the amendment — remark, notification, re-acceptance, old bids
cases.title: An empty remark object crashes the publish
cases.why: `{}` is blank, so `add_amendment_remarks!` raises a plain StandardError that nothing rescues (EDGE-PUB-107 covers the key being absent; this is the key present but empty).
cases.setup: Amendment draft.
cases.steps: Publish with `"amendment_remarks": {}`.
cases.expected: 422 'remarks required'. Today: 500 "Remarks for amendment not found", publish rolled back.
cases.oracle: Draft still draft after the 500.

cases.section: Publishing the amendment — remark, notification, re-acceptance, old bids
cases.title: The "Event Revised" mail and push reach only the latest commercial stage's vendors
cases.why: Recipients are `latest_commercial_stage.get_audiences`; an RFP-only event has no commercial stage, so its amendment notifies nobody, and vendors invited only to the RFP of an RFP+RFQ event are skipped.
cases.setup: An RFP-only live event, versioned and republished with a remark.
cases.steps: Publish the amendment; inspect queued EmailNotificationWorker / mails for each invited vendor.
cases.expected: Every invited vendor of every stage is told. Today: zero mails for RFP-only; the push worker also returns early.
cases.oracle: No `event_revise_notification_mailer` delivery.

cases.section: Publishing the amendment — remark, notification, re-acceptance, old bids
cases.title: Vendors' T&C popup acceptance is copied to the amended stage
cases.why: The replica is `trade_request.dup`; `misc.tnc_popup_acceptances` is not cleared (only bid_company_ids, savings and precomputed bids are), so a vendor who accepted v1's terms is treated as having accepted v2's — even when the amendment changed them.
cases.setup: `tnc_popup` enabled for rfq; vendor accepted on v1; amendment changes the terms and is published.
cases.steps: As the vendor, `GET /trade/<new stage>`.
cases.expected: `tnc_popup_accepted: false` on v2. Today: true.
cases.oracle: `misc.tnc_popup_acceptances` present on the new stage.

cases.section: Publishing the amendment — remark, notification, re-acceptance, old bids
cases.title: Participation intent is not carried to the new version
cases.why: Intents are stored against the event group id; v2 has a new id, so vendors must accept participation again — while their T&C acceptance (above) silently carries over. The two behaviours should match.
cases.setup: Vendor declared "accept" (`POST /user_intents`, intent_type trade_accept) on v1; amendment published.
cases.steps: As vendor, `GET /event_groups/<v2>` and read `user_intent`.
cases.expected: Product decision; today `user_intent` is null on v2.
cases.oracle: No user_intents row for v2.

cases.section: Publishing the amendment — remark, notification, re-acceptance, old bids
cases.title: Requisition mappings move to the new version
cases.why: A PR-linked event that is amended must keep its PR quantities in progress against v2, not v1.
cases.setup: PR-linked live event, amendment published.
cases.steps: Read the PR and its items' trade mappings.
cases.expected: v1 PR mappings in_active; v2 active; PR item in-progress quantities unchanged.
cases.oracle: purchase_request_trade_mappings rows.

cases.section: Editing a live event in place — the amendment bypass (`PATCH /event_groups/:id`)
cases.title: A negative quantity is stored on a live line item
cases.why: Nothing on this path validates the quantity; -5 on a published event breaks savings and awarding maths.
cases.setup: The sandbox event. Runs last.
cases.steps: `PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}` with the existing line item and `"quantity": {"unitSymbol": "KG", "value": -5}`.
cases.expected: Should be 422. Today: 200 and -5 stored.
cases.oracle: get_line_items shows -5.

cases.section: Editing a live event in place — the amendment bypass (`PATCH /event_groups/:id`)
cases.title: The only line item of a live event cannot be deleted
cases.why: An event with nothing to buy must be withdrawn, not emptied.
cases.setup: The sandbox event (exactly one line item).
cases.steps: `PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}` with body `{"line_items": [{"uuid": "{{lineItemUuid}}", "status": "deleted"}]}`.
cases.expected: HTTP 422, code 711 'You cannot delete this line item from the project'; line item still active.
cases.oracle: 422 code 711; get_line_items unchanged.

cases.section: Editing a live event in place — the amendment bypass (`PATCH /event_groups/:id`)
cases.title: An unknown product on a live line-item edit crashes the server
cases.why: A stale product id (product deactivated after publish) turns a buyer's edit into a 500, and the 8-second event lock is left behind.
cases.setup: The sandbox event.
cases.steps: `PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}` with `{"line_items": [{"uuid": "{{lineItemUuid}}", "product_uuid": "Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==", "quantity": {"unitSymbol": "KG", "value": 5}}]}`.
cases.expected: 422 (unknown product). Today: 500 — `product.id` on nil.
cases.oracle: Not 5xx.

cases.section: Editing a live event in place — the amendment bypass (`PATCH /event_groups/:id`)
cases.title: A new line item can be added to a live event without a stage line
cases.why: The new event line item is created as active but the live RFQ gets no trade product, so vendors cannot quote it and the award screen shows a line nobody bid on.
cases.setup: The sandbox event. Runs last (adds a second line item).
cases.steps: `PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}` with the existing line item plus `{"product_uuid": "{{productUuid}}", "product_quality_uuid": "{{productQualityUuid}}", "quantity": {"unitSymbol": "KG", "value": 3}}`.
cases.expected: Should be refused on a live event. Today: 200, two event line items, one quotable line.
cases.oracle: get_line_items count 2 vs `GET /trade/{{tradeId}}` trade_products count 1.

cases.section: Editing a live event in place — the amendment bypass (`PATCH /event_groups/:id`)
cases.title: A live rename happens only if an unrelated config key rides along
cases.why: A title alone is silently ignored (EDGE-CRT-020); the same title plus any config key renames the live event. The rule is accidental, and neither path tells vendors.
cases.setup: The sandbox event.
cases.steps: `PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}` with `{"title": "QA_Platform_LiveRetitle_{{stamp}}", "description": "QA_Platform_live_desc_{{stamp}}", "config": {"show_reference_id": false}}`.
cases.expected: A consistent rule (always allowed with notice, or always refused). Today: 200 and renamed.
cases.oracle: `GET` shows the new title.

cases.section: Editing a live event in place — the amendment bypass (`PATCH /event_groups/:id`)
cases.title: The event's terms can be replaced on a live event with no notice
cases.why: Vendors are held to terms they never saw; no remark, mail or acceptance reset.
cases.setup: The sandbox event. Runs last.
cases.steps: `PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}` with `{"config": {"show_reference_id": false}, "terms_and_conditions": {"clauses": ["QA_Platform_live_clause_{{stamp}}"], "attachments": []}}`.
cases.expected: Should require an amendment. Today: 200; terms replaced.
cases.oracle: `GET` terms show only the new clause.

cases.section: Editing a live event in place — the amendment bypass (`PATCH /event_groups/:id`)
cases.title: An extra key in the terms object crashes a live edit
cases.why: On a live event the terms object is only ever built on this path; EDGE-PUB-021 sends the same key down the publish branch, which does not build it for an active event.
cases.setup: The sandbox event.
cases.steps: `PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}` with `{"config": {"show_reference_id": false}, "terms_and_conditions": {"clauses": [], "attachments": [], "QA_Platform_extra": 1}}`.
cases.expected: 422. Today: 500 (ArgumentError, unknown keyword).
cases.oracle: Not 5xx.

cases.section: Editing a live event in place — the amendment bypass (`PATCH /event_groups/:id`)
cases.title: A config key can turn a live event into a BOQ event
cases.why: Config is merged with no allow-list; once `boq_based_rfx` is true, the next line-item edit deletes every line item not in the request.
cases.setup: The sandbox event. Runs last.
cases.steps: `PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}` with `{"config": {"boq_based_rfx": true}}`.
cases.expected: Should be refused. Today: 200 and `config.boq_based_rfx: true`.
cases.oracle: `GET` config.

cases.section: Editing a live stage in place (`PATCH /trade/:id`)
cases.title: A live stage's terms change with only a push, and earlier acceptances stand
cases.why: No email, no remark, and vendors who accepted the old terms still show as accepted.
cases.setup: The sandbox stage, no bids. Runs last.
cases.steps: `PATCH /trade/{{tradeId}}` with `{"terms_and_conditions": ["QA_Platform_amended_clause_{{stamp}}"]}`, then `GET /trade/{{tradeId}}`.
cases.expected: Should notify and reset acceptance. Today: 200; push "update_trade_notification" only; `misc.tnc_popup_acceptances` kept.
cases.oracle: New clause present; tnc_popup_accepted unchanged for a vendor who had accepted.

cases.section: Editing a live stage in place (`PATCH /trade/:id`)
cases.title: All terms can be cleared from a live stage
cases.why: Mandatory clauses vanish mid-bidding.
cases.setup: The sandbox stage. Runs last.
cases.steps: `PATCH /trade/{{tradeId}}` with `{"terms_and_conditions": []}`.
cases.expected: Should need a remark at least. Today: 200 and an empty list.
cases.oracle: `GET` shows no clauses.

cases.section: Editing a live stage in place (`PATCH /trade/:id`)
cases.title: A running stage cannot be rescheduled
cases.why: Moving the start of a live stage would reopen or cut bidding under vendors.
cases.setup: The sandbox stage (already started).
cases.steps: `PATCH /trade/{{tradeId}}` with `{"bid_start_time": 4102444800, "bid_end_time": 4102448400}`.
cases.expected: HTTP 422, code 258 'You cannot re-schedule this event!'.
cases.oracle: Schedules unchanged.

cases.section: Editing a live stage in place (`PATCH /trade/:id`)
cases.title: An unknown delivery schedule id crashes a live edit
cases.why: Outside the reschedule branch the schedule is looked up with no scope and no nil check.
cases.setup: The sandbox stage.
cases.steps: `PATCH /trade/{{tradeId}}` with `{"delivery_schedules": [{"id": 999999999, "delivery_by": 4102444800}]}`.
cases.oracle: Not 5xx.

cases.section: Editing a live stage in place (`PATCH /trade/:id`)
cases.title: Terms can change under a submitted bid while the window is open
cases.why: The API refuses T&C edits only when bids exist AND the window has closed; the screen hides the edit as soon as one bid exists. A vendor's submitted bid ends up against terms it was not priced on, and nothing flags the bid for revision.
cases.setup: Open stage with one submitted vendor bid (vendor session to place it; no twin — the sandbox has no bids).
cases.steps: `PATCH /trade/:id` with new terms.
cases.expected: Should be refused once any bid exists (matching the UI), or the bid flagged. Today: 200.
cases.oracle: Terms changed; bid status unchanged.

cases.section: Editing a live stage in place (`PATCH /trade/:id`)
cases.title: A price cap cannot be lowered below a bid already received
cases.why: After bids, only savings widgets, tick size and price cap can change; the cap must stay at or above the highest bid.
cases.setup: Open sheet-template RFQ with a bid of 100 (vendor session; no twin).
cases.steps: `PATCH /trade/:id` with `trade_products[0].validations.default.ceil_price = 50`.
cases.expected: HTTP 422 code 15 with "Price Cap should be greater than or equal to ₹ 100.0 … for <product>".
cases.oracle: Cap unchanged.

cases.section: Editing a live stage in place (`PATCH /trade/:id`)
cases.title: Replacing a sheet stage's lines before any bid discards vendors' saved drafts
cases.why: With no submitted bids the whole line set is rebuilt and every DRAFT bid is set in_active — a vendor's half-filled quote disappears without notice.
cases.setup: Open sheet-template RFQ; vendor has a saved draft bid, nothing submitted.
cases.steps: `PATCH /trade/:id` with a new `trade_products` sheet.
cases.expected: Product decision; today the draft bid becomes in_active and only a sheet-change push is sent.
cases.oracle: Draft bid status in_active.

cases.section: Amending after close (the journey's closed stage)
cases.title: A closed, awarded stage can still be renamed
cases.why: The title branch runs before the status allow-list, so the one record that should be frozen — a closed stage with bids and a submitted award — can be renamed.
cases.setup: `{{pricingTradeUuid}}` = the journey's pricing stage, closed, one bid, proposal submitted; `rfx_project_enabled` OFF (else 769); the journey's event was not versioned (else 101).
cases.steps: `PATCH /trade/{{pricingTradeUuid}}` with `{"title": "QA_Platform_ClosedStage_{{stamp}}"}`.
cases.expected: Should be refused. Today: 200.
cases.oracle: `GET /trade/{{pricingTradeUuid}}` title changed.

cases.section: Amending after close (the journey's closed stage)
cases.title: Terms cannot change on a closed stage that has bids
cases.why: Vendors priced against the terms in force when they bid.
cases.setup: As API-XDAMD-053.
cases.steps: `PATCH /trade/{{pricingTradeUuid}}` with `{"terms_and_conditions": ["QA_Platform_late_clause_{{stamp}}"]}`.
cases.expected: HTTP 422, code 4 'Request not found' — a misleading message for "closed with bids".
cases.oracle: Terms unchanged.

cases.section: Amending after close (the journey's closed stage)
cases.title: Line quantities, specs and price caps cannot change after close
cases.why: The award is computed from these lines.
cases.setup: As API-XDAMD-053.
cases.steps: `PATCH /trade/{{pricingTradeUuid}}` with `{"trade_products": [{"id": 999999999, "validations": {"default": {"ceil_price": 1}}}]}`.
cases.expected: HTTP 422, code 4 'Request not found'.
cases.oracle: Lines unchanged.

cases.section: Widgets, T&C acceptance and adding a stage to a live event
cases.title: A buyer cannot accept the vendor T&C popup
cases.why: Acceptance is a vendor's legal act; the buyer of the event must not be able to record it.
cases.setup: The sandbox stage; the buyer user is not also mapped as a vendor of the company.
cases.steps: `PATCH /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/accept_auction_tnc` with `{}`.
cases.expected: HTTP 422, code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action'.
cases.oracle: `misc.tnc_popup_acceptances` unchanged.

cases.section: Widgets, T&C acceptance and adding a stage to a live event
cases.title: A stage of one event cannot seed a stage in another event
cases.why: Without the link check a buyer could graft stages across events.
cases.setup: `{{pricingTradeUuid}}` (journey event) and `{{eventGroupUuid}}` (sandbox event); `is_add_new_stage_allowed` ON. PROCOL DEMO has it OFF (checked live 2026-10-03), so the runnable twin is held there.
cases.steps: `POST /v1/trade/{{pricingTradeUuid}}/add_new_stage_in_live_event` with `{"event_group_uuid": "{{eventGroupUuid}}"}`.
cases.expected: HTTP 422, code 2000 'Trade request and event group are not linked'.
cases.oracle: Neither event changes.

cases.section: Version guards and reading the audit trail back
cases.title: The version fields of a never-amended event
cases.why: Every amendment case compares against this baseline.
cases.setup: The sandbox event, not versioned.
cases.steps: `GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}`.
cases.expected: 200; `is_latest_version: true`, `item_versions: []`, `is_amendment_draft: null`, `amendment_remarks.remarks: null`, `config.can_create_new_version` true only if `is_event_versioning_enabled` is on and the caller is super admin or shares the owner's team.
cases.oracle: Field values as listed.

cases.section: Version guards and reading the audit trail back

cases.section: Version guards and reading the audit trail back
cases.title: Event and line-item edits have no readable change log
cases.why: Only six entity types are readable; amendments to the event group and its line items (which are recorded) cannot be read back through the API.
cases.setup: The sandbox event.
cases.steps: `GET /versions_log/all?entity_type=EventGroup&entity_uuid={{eventGroupUuid}}`.
cases.expected: HTTP 422, code 5 'Not authorized'.
cases.oracle: 422 code 5.

cases.title: The item type must be exactly "EventGroup"
cases.why: The type string is the only thing standing between the request and `constantize`; a "helpful" case-insensitive fix would widen it.
cases.setup: The sandbox event, published; nothing is versioned by this case.
cases.steps: `POST /item_versions` with body `{"item_uuid": "{{eventGroupUuid}}", "item_type": "eventgroup"}`. Then read the event back.
cases.expected: Refused as missing parameters; no new version, the event is still the latest. HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters'.
cases.oracle: 422 code 2; `GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}` still shows `is_latest_version: true` and `item_versions: []`.

cases.title: An item type sent as a list is refused before it reaches the class lookup
cases.why: A JSON array is not blank, so only the allow-list stops it reaching `item_type.constantize`, which would crash on an Array.
cases.setup: The sandbox event.
cases.steps: `POST /item_versions` with body `{"item_uuid": "{{eventGroupUuid}}", "item_type": ["EventGroup"]}`.
cases.expected: Refused, no crash. HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters'.
cases.oracle: 422 code 2, never 500; no version created.

cases.title: A garbled event id is a parameter error
cases.why: The id decodes to nothing; that must read as "bad request", not "not found" or a crash.
cases.setup: Any buyer.
cases.steps: `POST /item_versions` with body `{"item_uuid": "WrongUuid1=", "item_type": "EventGroup"}`.
cases.expected: HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — `item_uuid` becomes `item_id = nil`.
cases.oracle: 422 code 2.

cases.title: A raw text item_id does not crash the lookup
cases.why: The controller also accepts a raw `item_id`, which skips uuid decoding; its type handling is untested elsewhere.
cases.setup: Any buyer.
cases.steps: `POST /item_versions` with body `{"item_id": "QA_Platform_abc_{{stamp}}", "item_type": "EventGroup"}`.
cases.expected: HTTP 422, code 888 'Invalid Parameters'; not a 500.
